skill.summary: Assist in creating, running, and managing integration tests for APIs, databases, and services with orchestration, assertions, and reports.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of integration-testing-helper.

- Provides tools to design, run, and manage integration tests for APIs, databases, and services.
- Supports service orchestration, database setup, and complex end-to-end scenarios.
- Includes built-in assertion library and generates detailed test reports (HTML/JSON).
- Offers CI integration with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.
- Enables parallel test execution for faster workflows.
